argv: import fs from 'node:fs';import{buildWindowsProtectionFixture,buildWindowsProtectionSubfixture}from './src/windows-protection-lab.js';import{buildHeldObjects}from './src/held-objects.js';import{projectHeldObjects}from './src/held-object-state.js';const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('docs/windows-protection-expansion/protection-cases.json'));const ms=new Map();for(const r of p.cases){const m=buildWindowsProtectionFixture(r.modelId,r.variantId);ms.set(m.canonicalCaseId+'|'+m.subfixtureId,m)}for(const r of p.subfixtures){const m=buildWindowsProtectionSubfixture(r.id);ms.set(m.canonicalCaseId+'|'+m.subfixtureId,m)}const found=[];for(const m of ms.values()){const steps=m.steps(),c=buildHeldObjects({model:m,steps,actors:m.actors(),config:{},contextId:'missing-field:'+m.canonicalCaseId,choiceId:m.id});for(const [i,s]of steps.entries()){if(s.from!==s.to)continue;const rs=m.workstationInventory.events[s.id].milestones.flatMap(x=>x.effects).filter(e=>e.op==='release');if(!rs.length)continue;const before=projectHeldObjects(c,{eventIndex:i-1,milestone:i===0?'initial':'complete'}),after=projectHeldObjects(c,{eventIndex:i,milestone:'complete'});for(const h of before.holdings.filter(h=>!after.holdings.some(n=>n.holdingId===h.holdingId))){if(!s.attributeOperations.some(o=>o.instanceId===h.artifactId)){const a=m.workstationInventory.artifacts.find(a=>a.artifactId===h.artifactId);found.push({case:m.canonicalCaseId,member:m.subfixtureId,step:s.id,holding:h,artifact:a,operations:s.attributeOperations})}}}}console.log(JSON.stringify({missing:found.length,examples:found.slice(0,2)},null,2));
